hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.scss|*.html|*.md|*.mdx|*.yaml|*.yml) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; npx --no-install prettier --find-config-path "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostCompact","additionalContext":"Persona guardrails re-asserted after compaction (full rules in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md). Act as a senior peer: be concise, skip basics, recommend rather than survey. Prefer the simplest solution and challenge unclear requirements before coding. Git discipline: small logical commits, ask before any commit/push/branch, never add Co-Authored-By trailers. Write PR and code-review output in English. State assumptions explicitly."}}'

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cur=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; def=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^origin/@@'); [ -n "$def" ] || def=main; case "$cur" in "$def"|main|master) jq -n --arg b "$cur" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:("On default branch \($b). Create a feature branch first per your convention, or confirm to commit here.")}}';; esac; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '(.tool_input.content // "") + "\n" + (.tool_input.new_string // "")' 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq -e '-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}' && jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"Possible secret in this write (private key or cloud/token pattern). Confirm only if intentional."}}'; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; b=${f##*/}; case "$b" in .env.example|.env.sample|.env.template|.env.*.example) exit 0;; esac; case "$b" in .env|.env.*|*.pem|*.key|id_rsa|id_ed25519|*.p12|*.keystore|package-lock.json|npm-shrinkwrap.json|yarn.lock|pnpm-lock.yaml|bun.lockb) jq -n --arg f "$b" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:("Editing protected file \($f) (secret/key/lockfile). Confirm if intentional; lockfiles should be regenerated via the package manager.")}}';; esac; exit 0
m=$(jq -r '.message // empty' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"\\`$'); [ -n "$m" ] || m="Needs your attention"; osascript -e "display notification \"$m\" with title \"Claude Code\"" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
